## Submission type

- [ ] Scientific model
- [ ] Software change
- [ ] Documentation change

## Purpose and evidence

Describe the proposal or problem, the changes and relevant references. Link any GitHub Discussion. For scientific models, state the purpose, interpretive assumptions, limitations and relationship to existing models.

## Attribution and licence

For models or reused material, identify authors, sources, provenance, modifications and explicit licences. Link the contributed JSON, accompanying notes and catalogue entry. Identify SOIPS derivatives and confirm the original reference is preserved.

## Validation

Describe checks performed and their results, including unresolved issues:

- Scientific models: exported JSON reopened successfully; warnings reviewed; analysis targets, search limits and expected/observed results documented; incomplete results labelled.
- Software: relevant typecheck, tests, build and browser checks.
- Documentation: links checked and factual claims verified.

Scientific model acceptance does not establish scientific validity or endorsement.
